integrity: Complete analytic arguments and independently implementable numerical checks; numerical tests are not proofs or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed b>1, common disk radius and center locus equal to the unit circle; no b<=1, high-dimensional, nonuniform, or finite-sample normal-approximation rate statement.
The standard circular-spacing representation is prior theory, and the prior deterministic symmetric optimizer literature is acknowledged.
Historical equivalence elsewhere in the literature cannot be ruled out definitively.
title: Exact circular-gap area laws and Gaussian fluctuations for intersecting congruent disks
